item.title: Shut Up & Write!® at Aqus in Petaluma (in person) — Mon Aug 31, 10:30 AM
item.description:
Shut Up & Write!® Wine Country **Coworking for writers in Petaluma!** Join us for some focused writing time. All experience levels are welcome, and don’t worry, no one will see what you've written. This session is about getting some writing done, whether you're working on a novel, memoir, short story, dissertation, job application, blog, poetry, a song or just want to journal.
**Format** 10:30 - 10:45am: Introduce yourself and what you're working on today 10:45 - 11:45am: Write in silence for 1 hour 11:45am - 12pm: Check in with one another and exchange how it went
**Venue Details:**
* Aqus has WiFi for guests * Ample street parking is available * Please thank our hosts by purchasing something * If music or ambient noise are distracting, please bring ear plugs or headphones * There are a few outlets available if you need to charge your device
Source: Meetup: Shut Up & Write Wine Country
